tools.name: search_supplements
tools.description: Search the catalog of 993 evidence-graded supplements by name, category, or topic. Returns matches with slug, evidence grade, and summary. Use get_supplement for the full analysis.

tools.name: get_supplement
tools.description: Get the full evidence analysis for one supplement by slug: per-claim evidence grades, studied dose, safety, interactions, FAQ, PubMed references, purchase link (buyUrl), and the citable pageUrl (translated fields under "pt", "es", "de", "fr").

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List the comparison guides ("which form should you take?"): magnesium forms, creatine forms, vitamin C forms, omega-3 sources, protein powders, CoQ10 vs ubiquinol, iron, calcium, collagen types, fiber.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get one comparison guide by slug, with the compared options, per-option verdicts, and purchase links.

tools.name: search_training
tools.description: Search the evidence-graded training topics: training variables (sets, reps, rest, failure), methods (drop sets, HIIT, zone 2), exercises (squat, bench press…), weight-loss strategies and gym myths. Returns slug, type, grade and summary. Use get_training for the full page.

tools.name: get_training
tools.description: Get one training topic by slug: overall and per-claim grades, how to apply it (sets, reps, rest), technique for exercises, who should be careful, FAQ, PubMed references, the supplements from this catalog that help with its goals, and the citable pageUrl (translations under "pt", "es", "de", "fr").

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_supplement" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
